groendak.question: What does a green roof cost?
groendak.answer: An extensive sedum roof costs €40–€60 per m², intensive green roofs €80–€150 per m². For an average green roof of 30 m² you pay €1,200–€1,800 including installation.

groendak.question: What subsidies are available for green roofs in Friesland?
groendak.answer: Leeuwarden offers up to €15 per m², Súdwest-Fryslân has a climate adaptation subsidy (amount varies), and Smallingerland has occasional subsidy rounds. Your gardener helps with the application.

groendak.question: What is an extensive green roof?
groendak.answer: An extensive green roof is lightweight, low-maintenance and suitable for most sloped and flat roofs. The vegetation consists of sedum, mosses and herbs.

groendak.question: Can green roofs be combined with solar panels?
groendak.answer: Yes — green roofs and solar panels are an excellent combination. The vegetation keeps the panels cooler, which increases electricity yield.

groendak.question: Is my roof suitable for a green roof?
groendak.answer: Most flat or slightly sloped roofs are suitable, but we always check the load-bearing capacity, drainage and insulation. A roof structure assessment is part of our process.

groendak.question: How much maintenance does a green roof need?
groendak.answer: Extensive green roofs require minimal maintenance (1-2x per year). Intensive green roofs need more care, comparable to a regular garden.

stratenmaker.question: How long does paving last?
stratenmaker.answer: With correct installation and normal use, concrete pavers last 25-30 years, natural stone 50+ years. The quality of the foundation is crucial for longevity. Maintenance mainly consists of filling joints and occasional cleaning.

stratenmaker.question: Is a permit required for paving?
stratenmaker.answer: For paving your own property, a permit is usually not required. However, you must comply with the maximum paved area per plot (check your zoning plan). When connecting to the public road, a KLIC notification may be mandatory.

stratenmaker.question: Which material is best for my situation?
stratenmaker.answer: This depends on use, budget and aesthetics. Concrete pavers are versatile and affordable, natural stone is more durable but more expensive. For heavy traffic (driveways) we recommend reinforced pavers or natural stone. For terraces, ceramic tiles are popular.

stratenmaker.question: When is the best season for paving work?
stratenmaker.answer: Paving can be done almost year-round, except during frost. The best season is March-November. In winter, work can also be done in frost-free weather. For large projects we prefer to schedule during dry periods due to ground conditions.

tuinonderhoud.question: What does garden maintenance cost per month?
tuinonderhoud.answer: A garden maintenance subscription costs €60–€200 per month, depending on garden size and frequency. This fixed price is 10–20% more affordable than individual visits and ensures optimal garden maintenance all year round.

tuinonderhoud.question: How often should I have my garden maintained?
tuinonderhoud.answer: For a well-kept garden, we recommend monthly maintenance during the growing season (March–October) and 2–3 times per year in winter for seasonal tasks.

tuinonderhoud.question: What are the benefits of a garden maintenance subscription?
tuinonderhoud.answer: Fixed lower price per visit (10–20% discount), no scheduling hassle, your garden is always cared for, and flexible visit frequency tailored to season and needs.

tuinonderhoud.question: What work is included in garden maintenance?
tuinonderhoud.answer: Lawn mowing and edging, hedge trimming, weed removal, pruning, leaf clearing, winterizing, fertilizing and seasonal planting.

tuinonderhoud.question: Do you also provide garden maintenance for businesses?
tuinonderhoud.answer: Yes, our gardeners provide green maintenance for business premises, homeowner associations and municipal green spaces. Request a quote for a custom contract.

tuinontwerp.question: What does a professional garden design cost in Friesland?
tuinontwerp.answer: A complete garden design ranges from €750-2500, depending on size and complexity. This includes concept design, plant selection, 3D visualization and technical drawings.

tuinontwerp.question: How long does the design process take?
tuinontwerp.answer: From first consultation to final design takes on average 2-4 weeks. This depends on the size of your garden and desired level of detail.

tuinontwerp.question: Will I get 3D visualizations of my new garden?
tuinontwerp.answer: Yes, with every garden design we deliver professional 3D renders so you can see your new garden before construction begins.

tuinontwerp.question: Can you also handle the construction?
tuinontwerp.answer: Absolutely! We work together with experienced gardening companies who can realize the design exactly according to specifications.

tuinontwerp.question: Do you consider maintenance-friendliness?
tuinontwerp.answer: Certainly. We always design with the desired maintenance level in mind and choose plants that match your available time and experience.

tuin-aanleggen.question: What does garden installation cost per m²?
tuin-aanleggen.answer: The costs for garden installation vary greatly depending on materials and complexity. On average, expect from €50 per m² for a complete installation including planting and paving.

tuin-aanleggen.question: How long does it take to install a garden?
tuin-aanleggen.answer: An average garden of 100-150 m² is typically completed within 2 to 3 weeks. Larger or more complex projects may take slightly longer.

tuin-aanleggen.question: Is there a guarantee on garden installation?
tuin-aanleggen.answer: Yes, we provide a 2-year guarantee on all our installation work. This applies to structural elements such as paving and constructions. For planting, a one-growing-season planting guarantee applies.

tuin-aanleggen.question: What season is best to have a garden installed?
tuin-aanleggen.answer: Garden installation is possible year-round, but spring and autumn are the most favourable periods. During these seasons, plants root better and the soil is easier to work with.

tuin-aanleggen.question: Can I also have an existing garden renovated?
tuin-aanleggen.answer: Absolutely. We not only create new gardens but also handle complete renovations of existing gardens, including removing old elements and redesigning the layout.
